item.title: Natsuiro Yakou
item.description:

  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 夏色夜行
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Yakou

あらすじ

“I want to… be here…”

My cousin Tsuya Mikage was waiting for me when I got home. We first met six months ago at my aunt’s funeral.

These were extenuating circumstances, and if it was just one night…

I let him stay.

But that night, from the witching hour, our bodies came together…

“I want to be here. I’m… exposed? I’m trapped in my family.”

item.title: Mitsugetsu no Chou ~Boku, Maid Hajimemashita~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Black Camellia
  • 発売日: 2013-12-31
  • スコア: 5.89/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 蜜月の蝶～ぼく、メイドはじめました～
  • 英語名: Mitsugetsu no Chou Boku, Maid Hajimemashita

あらすじ

“Your parents sold you, huh.”

The beautiful sisters eyed me with a mixture of mischief and disdain. It was an extravagant huge house.

They gave me a red collar and a black collar.

From that night, and for every night, I was to wear a collar

and do the bidding of the older or younger sister.
